mapper.sql: SELECT R.RQT_MTTR_SN AS rqtMttrSn, R.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, R.RQT_MTTR_NO AS rqtMttrNo, R.CLSF_NM AS clsfNm, R.RQT_MTTR_NM AS rqtMttrNm, R.RQT_MTTR_DFN AS rqtMttrDfn, R.DTL_CN AS dtlCn, R.PAGE_NO AS pageNo, R.TOC_SN AS tocSn, R.RGTR_ID AS rgtrId, T.TOC_NO AS tocNo, T.TOC_NM AS tocNm, T.PIC_ID AS picId, U.USER_NM AS picNm FROM TB_RQT_MTTR R LEFT JOIN TB_TOC T ON T.TOC_SN = R.TOC_SN LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = T.PIC_ID
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RQT_MTTR WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND RQT_MTTR_NO = #{rqtMttrNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_RQT_MTTR (PBANC_SN, RQT_MTTR_NO, CLSF_NM, RQT_MTTR_NM, RQT_MTTR_DFN, DTL_CN, PAGE_NO, RGTR_ID) VALUES (#{pbancSn}, #{rqtMttrNo}, #{clsfNm}, #{rqtMttrNm}, #{rqtMttrDfn}, #{dtlCn}, #{pageNo}, #{rgtrId})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_RQT_MTTR SET TOC_SN = #{tocSn, jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE RQT_MTTR_SN = #{rqtMttrSn}
mapper.select: SELECT T.TOC_SN AS tocSn, T.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, T.UP_TOC_SN AS upTocSn, T.TOC_SE_CD AS tocSeCd, T.PIC_ID AS picId, T.PIC_CO_NM AS picCoNm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC C WHERE C.UP_TOC_SN = T.TOC_SN) AS childCnt FROM TB_TOC T WHERE T.TOC_SN = #{tocSn}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_TOC WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND PIC_ID = #{userId}
